sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [G]The Lord is my light; then why should I [D7]fear?
[D7]By day [G]and by night His [C]presence is [G]near;
[G/D]He is my salvation from sorrow and [D7]sin;
[D7]This blessed persuasion the [G]Spirit bring in.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [G/B]The Lord [C]is my light, [G]my joy, and [D7]my [G]song;
[G]By day and by night He leads me along;
[D]The Lord is [G]my light, my joy, and my song;
[Bm]By day and by night [Em]He leads [Am]me along.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [G]The Lord is my light; though clods may arise,
[D7]Faith, stronger [G]than sight, looks [C]up to the [G]skies
[G/D]Where Jesus forever in glory doth [D7]reign:
[D7]Then how can I ever in [G]darkness remain?

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [G]The Lord is my light, the Lord is my [D7]strength;
[D7]I know [G]in His might I'll [C]conquer at [G]length;
[G/D]My weakness in mercy He covers with power,
[D7]And, walking by faith, He upholds [G]me each hour.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [G]The lord is my light, my all and in [D7]all;
[D7]There is [G]in His sight no [C]darkness at [G]all;
[G/D]He is my Redeemer, my Savior and [D7]King;
[D7]With saints and with angels His [G]praises I sing.
